title: Molecular dynamics of estrogen-related receptors and their regulatory proteins: roles in transcriptional control for endocrine and metabolic signaling.
one_liner_zh: 综述ERR核受体的亚细胞动态与转录调控，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，仅部分相关。
abstract: Estrogen-related receptor (ERR) is a member of the nuclear receptor (NR) superfamily and has three subtypes alpha, beta, and gamma. Despite their strong homology with estrogen receptor (ER) alpha, ERRs cannot accommodate endogenous hormones. However, they are able to regulate gene expression without ligand binding. ERRalpha and ERRgamma orchestrate the expression of genes involved in bioenergetic pathways, while ERRbeta controls placental development and stem cell maintenance. Evidence from recent studies, including clinical research, has also demonstrated close associations of ERRs with the pathophysiology of hormone-related cancers and metabolic disorders including type 2 diabetes mellitus. This review summarizes the basic knowledge and recent advances in ERRs and their associated proteins, focusing on the subcellular dynamics involved in transcriptional regulation. Fluorescent protein labeling enabled monitoring of ERRs in living cells and revealed previously unrecognized characteristics. Using this technique, we demonstrated a role of ERRbeta in controlling estrogen signaling by regulating the subnuclear dynamics of ligand-activated ERalpha. Visualization of ERRs and related proteins and subsequent analyses also revealed a function of ERRgamma in promoting liver lactate metabolism in association with LRPGC1, a recently identified lactic acid-responsive protein. These findings suggest that ERRs activate unique transregulation mechanisms in response to extracellular stimuli such as hormones and metabolic signals, implying an adaptive system behind the cellular homeostatic regulation by orphan NRs. Control of subcellular ERR dynamics will contribute toward the development of therapeutic approaches to treat various diseases including hormone-related cancers and metabolic disorders associated with abnormal ERR signaling pathways.
abstract_zh: 雌激素相关受体（ERR）是核受体（NR）超家族的一员，包含α、β和γ三种亚型。尽管与雌激素受体（ER）α具有高度同源性，ERRs无法容纳内源性激素，但能在无配体结合的情况下调节基因表达。ERRα和ERRγ协调参与生物能量代谢途径的基因表达，而ERRβ则控制胎盘发育和干细胞维持。近期研究（包括临床研究）的证据也表明，ERRs与激素相关癌症及包括2型糖尿病在内的代谢疾病的病理生理学密切相关。本综述总结了ERRs及其相关蛋白的基础知识和最新进展，重点关注转录调控中的亚细胞动态。荧光蛋白标记技术使得在活细胞中监测ERRs成为可能，并揭示了先前未被认识的特征。利用该技术，我们证明了ERRβ通过调节配体激活的ERα的核内动态来控制雌激素信号传导的作用。对ERRs及相关蛋白的可视化及后续分析还揭示了ERRγ在促进肝脏乳酸代谢中的功能，该功能与最近发现的乳酸响应蛋白LRPGC1相关。这些发现表明，ERRs响应于激素和代谢信号等细胞外刺激激活独特的反式调控机制，暗示了孤儿核受体在细胞稳态调节背后的适应性系统。控制ERR亚细胞动态将有助于开发治疗各种疾病的方法，包括与异常ERR信号通路相关的激素相关癌症和代谢疾病。
